verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs confirm a Dashboard with session status views, a defined 'conversion rate' (funnel completion) metric, and per-session risk-factor breakdowns, which are core building blocks for funnel analytics. However, there is no evidence of segmented analytics by country or document type, explicit drop-off point identification, or completion-time metrics. Missing for 10: country/document-type segmented pass rates, drop-off funnel visualization, completion-time analytics.
